title: Chapter 49 — Territory Mapping and The Target List
intro: Sizing your market, finding every buyer, and building the ranked target list.

sections.title: Know Your Market
sections.content:
Before you prospect, map your territory. Who are the builders? The contractors? The designers? The property managers? How many projects are they running? What is their typical scope?

Build a ranked list based on potential volume, accessibility, and strategic fit. Then work the list systematically — not randomly.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating territory management, ask:

Does the salesperson have a documented target list — or are they prospecting randomly?
Is the list ranked by potential — or alphabetical?
Are they working the list consistently — or sporadically?
